Planned Power outage all day, Tried to go fishing, got to the good trout pond, untied one rope and it started to rain. So we took a drive to Camp, Welcome to Camp

First time out at camp since the spring, I don't really like going out there too much, I always end up doing more chores then fishing. But it is a nice place, great fishing. Grabbed an old tacklebox and minnow trap while we were out there, set the trap in my perch pond, and took a nice wet hike today too.
Looks very peaceful. I'm sure you and your son get some real quality time in there.

Honestly we'd usually rather just pitch a tent somewhere, going to camp means lots of chores, cutting firewood, cutting grass, trimming the road, breaking the beaver damn at the beaver pond on the road, and general camp maintenance, last year we had a bad bat problem and had to tear a lot of stuff up to get them out and clean their shit.

But no it is a special place, softest water I've ever seen, if you swim and bathe in it you come out feeling amazing with super soft hair and skin.

Perfectly drinkable too if you go to the middle of the lake, it's one of the deeper lakes up here, it gets over 100ft deep and has lake trout in the holes, tonnes of whitefish, walleye and huge pike.

Also one of the only places I know of up here with salamanders.
And the Sign above the old phone says "Not without a washer"
Planned power outage? Huh. I guess I'm too deep into civilization. There would be riots here if they tried that.

YA it's a tiny town in the middle of no where, the power actually comes from a hydro dam on a river about 45 minutes away. Came home to learn that the water treatement centers generator fucked up and now we're on a boil water advisory too.
